operation.name: pm
operation.description:
This command evaluates the expression given in argument as in PixelMath tool. The full expression must be between double quotes and variables (that are image names, without extension, located in the working directory in that case) must be surrounded by the token $, e.g. "$image1$ * 0.5 + $image2$ * 0.5". A maximum of 10 images can be used in the expression.

Image can be rescaled with the option -rescale followed by low and high values in the range [0, 1]. If no low and high values are provided, default values are set to 0 and 1. Another optional argument, -nosum tells Siril not to sum exposure times. This impacts FITS keywords such as LIVETIME and STACKCNT

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.

help:
Siril 1.4.4. This command evaluates the expression given in argument as in PixelMath tool. The full expression must be between double quotes and variables (that are image names, without extension, located in the working directory in that case) must be surrounded by the token $, e.g. "$image1$ * 0.5 + $image2$ * 0.5". A maximum of 10 images can be used in the expression.

Image can be rescaled with the option -rescale followed by low and high values in the range [0, 1]. If no low and high values are provided, default values are set to 0 and 1. Another optional argument, -nosum tells Siril not to sum exposure times. This impacts FITS keywords such as LIVETIME and STACKCNT

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.

Filenames in expressions are replaced by explicit $0, $1, … fixed image inputs; arbitrary disk paths are rejected.

runtime is a JSON object. Supported keys: ini, settings, threads, memory_ratio, output_bits, compression, online, selection, findstar, photometry. Networking starts offline and must be enabled explicitly. Selection is omitted for the whole image or explicitly null to clear it; optional CLI arguments use separate use_* controls. Connect transforms to an explicit export, stacking, or analysis endpoint. Only requested dependencies are executed; previews do not make other branches endpoints. Saved output references identify complete checked files, never preview pixels. See reference/coverage.json and docs/usage.md.
limitations: Filenames in expressions are replaced by explicit $0, $1, … fixed image inputs; arbitrary disk paths are rejected.
